        <!-- ── WORK MODE PANEL — Snowflake Intelligence ────────
             The Snowflake Intelligence frame is composed from three
             pre-baked SVG assets in /hero-assets/: si-sidenav.svg
             (persistent left nav), si-greeting.svg (headline), and
             si-input.svg (input pill). Using images instead of
             inline markup keeps the DOM tiny, skips web-font loads,
             and matches Figma pixel-for-pixel.

             State 2 stays as an empty placeholder — the crossfade
             from State 1 still runs the first time the user clicks
             Work (see playWorkTransition in the script). -->
        <div class="mode-panel inactive" id="work-panel">

          <div class="titlebar">
            <div class="traffic-lights">
              <div class="tl tl-r"></div>
              <div class="tl tl-y"></div>
              <div class="tl tl-g"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="wi-title">Snowflake CoWork</div>
          </div>

          <div class="wi-body">

            <!-- Persistent Snowflake Intelligence sidebar -->
            <aside class="wi-sidebar">
              <img src="https://www.snowflake.com/content/dam/snowflake-site/general/static/images/si-sidenav.svg" alt="Snowflake Intelligence navigation: New chat, Artifacts, Agents, Search chats, and today's conversations" width="280" height="1024">
            </aside>

            <!-- Main area — holds State 1 and State 2 absolute-stacked -->
            <div class="wi-main">

              <!-- ── STATE 1 — skills input entry point ───────── -->
              <!-- Each image is wrapped in a block whose background
                   acts as a skeleton placeholder. When Work is inactive
                   (#work-panel.hidden), the wrappers fill with light
                   gray and the images fade to 0 opacity, reading as
                   "loading" while Code is in focus. The three blocks
                   (line-one, line-two, input) have staggered fade
                   delays so they hydrate in sequence. -->
              <div class="wi-view wi-state-1">
                <div class="wi-headline">
                  <div class="wi-line-one-wrap">
                    <img class="wi-line-one" src="https://www.snowflake.com/content/dam/snowflake-site/general/static/images/line-one.svg" alt="Good afternoon, Jennifer." width="459" height="37">
                  </div>
                  <div class="wi-line-two-wrap">
                    <img class="wi-line-two" src="https://www.snowflake.com/content/dam/snowflake-site/general/static/images/line-two.svg" alt="What insights are you looking for?" width="577" height="40">
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="wi-input-wrap">
                  <img class="wi-input-img" src="https://www.snowflake.com/content/dam/snowflake-site/general/static/images/si-input.svg" alt="show me the latest /week-pulse for the entire sales team" width="804" height="80">
                </div>
              </div><!-- /wi-state-1 -->

              <!-- ── STATE 2 — query submitted + AI response ───
                   The greeting + input fade out; the prompt bubble
                   slides in top-right (user's sent message), then
                   the AI responses fade + rise in below, left
                   aligned like assistant messages in a chat. -->
              <div class="wi-view wi-state-2">
                <img class="wi-prompt" src="https://www.snowflake.com/content/dam/snowflake-site/general/static/images/si-prompt.svg" alt="show me the latest /week-pulse for the entire sales team" width="475" height="51">
                <img class="wi-response wi-response-1" src="https://www.snowflake.com/content/dam/snowflake-site/general/static/images/response-1.svg" alt="AI response with key insights" width="643" height="94">
                <img class="wi-response wi-response-2" src="https://www.snowflake.com/content/dam/snowflake-site/general/static/images/response-2.svg" alt="AI follow-up response" width="402" height="68">
                <div class="wi-chart-group">
                  <img class="wi-response-chart" src="https://www.snowflake.com/content/dam/snowflake-site/general/static/images/response-chart.svg" alt="Chart visualizing the AI response data" width="856" height="448">
                  <!-- Animated sales-growth line overlay.
                       Stroke length is hidden via dashoffset at init;
                       GSAP animates it to 0 so the line "draws on"
                       as the chart appears. -->
                  <svg class="wi-chart-line-overlay"
                       viewBox="0 0 856 448"
                       preserveAspectRatio="none"
                       fill="none"
                       aria-hidden="true"
                       xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                    <path class="wi-chart-line"
                          d="M134 289L301.5 273.848L390.5 139.027L477 161.291H574L668 250L772 125.48"
                          stroke="#126FE7"
                          stroke-width="1.5347"/>
                    <!-- Endpoint echo ring — expands and fades out
                         after the dot lands, giving the final beat
                         a soft landing instead of a hard stop. -->
                    <circle class="wi-chart-line-end-pulse"
                            cx="772" cy="125.48" r="5"
                            fill="none"
                            stroke="#126FE7"
                            stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <!-- Endpoint marker — pops in as the line finishes
                         drawing. Gives the hero beat its punctuation. -->
                    <circle class="wi-chart-line-end"
                            cx="772" cy="125.48" r="5"
                            fill="#126FE7"/>
                  </svg>
                </div>
              </div>

            </div><!-- /wi-main -->

          </div><!-- /wi-body -->
        </div><!-- /work-panel -->
